by_country_then_family 9189c3c8031a.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
by_country_then_family 9189c3c8031a.sql:
WITH g AS (SELECT "country", "family", count(*) AS c,
				ROUND(count(*)::DOUBLE / SUM(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY "country"), 4) AS s
				FROM events WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' GROUP BY "country", "family"),
			t AS (SELECT sum(c) AS total FROM g),
			top AS (SELECT * FROM g ORDER BY c DESC, "country" ASC NULLS LAST, "family" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 4)
			SELECT * EXCLUDE (o) FROM (
				SELECT 0 AS o, "country", "family", c, s FROM top
				UNION ALL
				SELECT 1, 'Other', 'Other', sum(c), ROUND(sum(c)::DOUBLE / any_value(total), 4) FROM g, t
				WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM top WHERE top."country" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM g."country" AND top."family" = g."family"))
			ORDER BY o, c DESC, "country" ASC NULLS LAST, "family" ASC NULLS LAST

country_with_other 2474e651d442.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
country_with_other 2474e651d442.sql:
WITH g AS (SELECT "country", count(*) AS c FROM events WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' GROUP BY "country"),
			t AS (SELECT sum(c) AS total FROM g),
			top AS (SELECT * FROM g ORDER BY c DESC, "country" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2)
			SELECT * EXCLUDE (o) FROM (
				SELECT 0 AS o, "country", c, c::DOUBLE / total FROM top, t
				UNION ALL
				SELECT 1, 'Other', sum(c), sum(c)::DOUBLE / any_value(total) FROM g, t
				WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM top WHERE top."country" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM g."country"))
			ORDER BY o, c DESC, "country" ASC NULLS LAST

filtered_share d31bb2ff9d44.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
filtered_share d31bb2ff9d44.sql:
SELECT "path", count(*) AS c, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE "family" = 'views'))::DOUBLE
				/ SUM(count(*) FILTER (WHERE "family" = 'views')) OVER ()
				FROM events WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' GROUP BY "path" ORDER BY c DESC, "path" ASC NULLS LAST

measures_weight 46da475f487b.sql:
SELECT "event_name", SUM(1 / sample_rate) / SUM(SUM(1 / sample_rate)) OVER (), count(*)::DOUBLE / SUM(count(*)) OVER ()
				FROM measures WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' GROUP BY "event_name" ORDER BY "event_name" ASC NULLS LAST

trend_by_country 49d78c9768f3.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
trend_by_country 49d78c9768f3.sql:
WITH top AS (SELECT "country" FROM events WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' GROUP BY "country"
				ORDER BY count(*) DESC, "country" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2),
			d AS (SELECT "day", "country", count(*)::DOUBLE / SUM(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY "day") AS s
				FROM events WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' GROUP BY "day", "country")
			SELECT "day", d."country", s FROM d JOIN top ON d."country" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM top."country"
			ORDER BY "day", d."country" ASC NULLS LAST
